comparison.objective: Tune a damper versus inspect a bent tube by seating it in a checking fixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key and collar manipulation with dynamic trials versus bimanual level transport and simultaneous four-leg slot insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Repeatable safe deceleration versus all four legs seated within fixture tolerances and released at rest.
comparison.reason: Both involve inspection, but they test different physical phenomena and manipulation. Candidate response tolerances remain partly undeclared.
